sources.label: Credit cards MITC lounge and rewards

conflicts: Product-page marketing describes 3-2-1 rewards. The MITC only states 1 reward point per ₹200.
disclaimer: This summary is for convenience. The issuer MITC prevails. The Federal listing page returned 403 on full fetch, so lounge quotas and welcome vouchers remain unconfirmed.

joining.summary: The MITC lists Signet joining and annual as ₹750.

annual_waiver.summary: Spend ₹75,000 in a year excluding cash to waive the next year's annual fee.

fuel_surcharge.notes: The family charges MITC lists fuel surcharge waiver for Imperio and Celesta only, not Signet.

base_earn.summary: The MITC states 1 reward point per ₹200 of spend in the enterprise pool with debit and netbanking. There are no points on cash, fuel, or e-wallet load.

accelerated.summary: Signet marketing and customer-benefit terms describe 3x rewards on electronics and apparel, 2x on entertainment, and 1x on other categories, while the charges MITC table still shows 1 point per ₹200.
accelerated.notes: Prefer MITC for base accrual; treat multipliers as product-page benefits until both align.

upi.notes: Federal credit-card MITC does not describe a separate UPI earn rate for Signet.

redemption.summary: The redemption fee is ₹99. Points are forfeited on death, fraud, or arrears. Catalogue options are otherwise unknown.

expiry.notes: Checked issuer MITC and product materials on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not offered for this SKU.

summary.summary: Primary cardholders receive one complimentary domestic airport lounge visit per calendar quarter when they spend at least ₹20,000 in the preceding calendar quarter.

domestic.summary: Signet includes one domestic lounge visit per quarter after ₹20,000 spend in the preceding calendar quarter.

conditions.summary: Spend at least ₹20,000 in the preceding calendar quarter.

international.notes: Federal lounge schedule lists international access for Celesta only; Signet shows NA for international lounge.

railway.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

dining.notes: Federal Signet MITC and lounge schedule do not describe a standalone dining discount programme separate from the 3-2-1 rewards multipliers.

movies.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

golf.notes: Golf benefits are documented for Celesta in Federal materials, not for Signet.

concierge.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

travel.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

accident.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

card_protect.notes: Checked issuer MITC on 2026-10-04; this benefit is not listed for this card variant.

milestones.summary: The documented spend milestone is ₹75,000 annual-fee waiver.

welcome.summary: RuPay Signet marketing lists onboarding benefits including Amazon Pay e-voucher and INOX movie offers subject to separate T&C PDFs.
